style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, deep espresso-brown #2A1710 flat panels for benefit and detail screens, soft oat-cream #F4ECE0 surfaces for comparison, flat-lay and spec layouts
style.iconSystem: consistent circular thin-line icon badges in the single ember-orange accent #C8551E
style.lightingSystem: warm directional studio lighting, soft front-left key at 4500K with gentle fill and soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars, occasional subtle ember-orange rim
style.lockText: consistent warm winter thermal-wear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, deep espresso-brown #2A1710 info panels, oat-cream #F4ECE0 flat-lay surfaces, one ember-orange accent #C8551E, with dark-brown #3A2A22 reserved for body text on light surfaces; warm tone; warm directional studio lighting with a soft front-left key at 4500K, gentle fill and soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent circular thin-line icon badges in the single ember-orange accent #C8551E; clean high-end knitwear product photography mixed with minimal flat infographic elements; stable garment scale and slightly-three-quarter hero angle across the set with faces never the focus; compositions filled by the garment and its supporting copy blocks; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no changing the ember-orange accent.
style.presentationRules: stable garment scale and slightly-three-quarter hero angle across the set; garment shown flat, on an invisible ghost mannequin, or worn cropped at the neck so the face is never the focus
style.surfaceSystem: matte oat-cream #F4ECE0 flat-lay board and smooth deep espresso-brown #2A1710 info panels
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines, dark brown #3A2A22 text on light surfaces and #FFFFFF text on the deep espresso-brown panels, no serif, no handwritten or brush lettering
